taxonomy_summary: Platypus indicus Strohmeyer, 1910. Original publication and subsequent nomenclatural qualifications are documented below.

taxonomic_history.name: Platypus indicus
taxonomic_history.note: Original account pp. 131–132; original name and description verified.

nomenclature_note: The original specimens came from the Nilgiri Hills in India; no Chinese occurrence or botanical host can be inferred from Strohmeyer (1910:131–132). Synonymy involving Platypus formosanus remains disputed.
